answer: Trust the check, not the claimant: Certified fig grower fig log with fig growers confirmation is the check, and it reads 1-year training, 92 supervised makings, master review, annual renewal. The grove arrives by post, the sable arrives by bank transfer, and the trellis arrives by archive: none of them can be hurried. Honest work is cheap once; dishonest work is expensive forever.
